data.name: Asla
data.gender_notes: Asla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asla is a Quranic name derived from the Arabic root asl, meaning 'submission to Allah'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes complete dedication and obedience to God, making it a powerful and spiritual choice for a baby girl. The name Asla carries the meaning “Submission to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asla usually hope their child will grow to embody submission to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of our duty to submit to Allah
data.etymology: Asla belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Submission to Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asla total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hindi.name: असला
in_hindi.meaning: असला का अर्थ है प्रार्थना करना या पूजा करना, यह नाम अरबी में से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है पवित्रता और स्वच्छता
in_hindi.long_meaning: असला का अर्थ है पूजा करना या प्रार्थना करना, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है पवित्रता और स्वच्छता। अस्ला का अर्थ है नमाज़ करना या पूजा करना, यह नाम हारोन के बेटे अस़र का है जो मिस्र का राजा था। अस्ला के कई भाई थे, जिनमें से एक का नाम राम था, जो मिस्र का राजा बन गया। अस्ला के बाद राम ने مصر की राजगद्दी संभाली और 1000 वर्षों तक मिस्र के राजाओं में रहा।

in_english.name: Asla
in_english.meaning: Asla, a male given name of Arabic origin, means "prayer" or "worship".
in_english.long_meaning: Asla is a male given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root word "asl," which means "prayer" or "worship." In Islamic tradition, Asla is considered a name that signifies spiritual growth and devotion to one's faith. The name Asla is also associated with the Quranic concept of salah, or prayer, which is considered a fundamental aspect of Islamic practice. In some cultures, Asla is also seen as a symbol of purity and cleanliness, reflecting the importance of spiritual cleansing and renewal in Islamic tradition. Asla is also the name of a character in Islamic history, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, who was known for his piety and devotion to his faith.
